# HOT components (AI index, generated by npm run agent-docs)

RULES
- Use only these components. Missing component/icon/behaviour: tell the user which, never draw a copy.
- Colours/fonts: CSS vars only (`var(--slateTextBody)`), no hex. Spacing/radius/icon sizes: `--spacingN` (N=px/4), `--radiusN` (N=px), `--iconSizeXs|Sm|Md|Lg` when the value matches.
- Icons: `<Icon name size={14|16|24} />` (14 marks, 16 buttons/rows). No own SVG.
- Never start Storybook. Run `npm run dev` only. Each component imports its own CSS; tokens/fonts load in src/main.tsx.
- Page shell: `PageLayout` variant home (nav, sidebar, content, rightPanel) | admin (nav, sidebar, subNav, content). Snippets: docs/recipes.md.
- Before using a component read docs/<Name>.md (props, defaults, example). Do not open files in src/components or src/patterns.

COLOUR TOKENS: var(--<family><Role><Variant>), e.g. var(--slateTextBody). Roles: Text, Surface, Border, Icons.
slate: Text[Title/Body/Subtle/Caption/Disabled] Surface[White/Subtle/Subtle100Hover/Slate150/Subtle200/Subtle300/Default/Dark500/Dark600/Darkest/Disabled] Border[Default/Dark/Light/Mild] Icons[Active/Subtle/Disabled]
primary: Text[Label] Surface[Subtle/Lighter/Default/MildDark/Dark] Border[Subtle/Lighter/Default/Dark]
primaryPurple: Text[Label] Surface[Subtle/Lighter/Default/Dark] Border[Subtle/Lighter/Default/Dark]
success: Text[Title/Body/Subtle/Caption/Disabled] Surface[Default/Subtle/Dark] Border[Default/Dark/Light]
warning: Text[Title/Body/Subtle/Caption/Disabled] Surface[Default/Subtle/Dark] Border[Default/Dark/Light]
error: Text[Title/Body/Subtle/Caption/Disabled] Surface[Default/Subtle/Dark/Disabled] Border[Default/Dark/Light]
blue: Text[Title/Body/Subtle/Caption/Disabled] Surface[Default/Subtle/Dark/Disabled] Border[Default/Dark/Light]
indigo: Text[Title/Body/Subtle/Caption/Disabled] Surface[Default/Subtle/Dark/Disabled] Border[Default/Dark/Light]
pastelViolet,pastelLightBlue,pastelRed,pastelPurple,pastelOrange,pastelYellow,pastelGreen: Surface/Text/Border, same variants
